additional_condition_unresolved.message: The rule contains an additional condition that Regulens cannot evaluate automatically.
additional_condition_unresolved.reviewer_action: Check the additional condition in the source against the formulation.

applicability_condition_not_met.message: The submitted product use does not meet a listed condition.
applicability_condition_not_met.reviewer_action: Review the product use against the exact source condition.

applicability_fact_missing.message: A product-use fact required by the rule is missing.
applicability_fact_missing.reviewer_action: Confirm the product-use fact identified by the rule.

combined_limit_information_missing.message: The rule limits the combined amount of related constituents, but the complete compatible total is unavailable.
combined_limit_information_missing.reviewer_action: Confirm whether the related constituents are present and verify their combined concentration.

concentration_basis_mismatch.message: The submitted concentration and the rule use different concentration bases.
concentration_basis_mismatch.reviewer_action: Confirm the concentration using the basis stated in the rule.

concentration_missing.message: The applicable rule needs concentration information that was not supplied.
concentration_missing.reviewer_action: Provide the concentration, unit, basis, and preparation stage required by the rule.

concentration_range_inconclusive.message: The reported range or approximate value cannot be conclusively compared with the rule limit.
concentration_range_inconclusive.reviewer_action: Confirm an exact concentration or review the full reported interval against the limit.

concentration_rule_not_executable.message: The source concentration condition is not represented as one safely executable comparison.
concentration_rule_not_executable.reviewer_action: Review the original concentration wording and its applicable branch.

concentration_semantics_incompatible.message: The submitted concentration and the rule use incompatible measurement semantics.
concentration_semantics_incompatible.reviewer_action: Confirm the concentration using the unit, basis, and stage stated in the rule.

concentration_unit_mismatch.message: The submitted concentration and the rule use different units.
concentration_unit_mismatch.reviewer_action: Confirm the concentration using the unit stated in the rule.

identity_genuine_conflict.message: The submitted name and CAS number match different source-backed ingredient identities.
identity_genuine_conflict.reviewer_action: Confirm the correct ingredient name and CAS number.

identity_multiple_candidates.message: More than one source-backed identity remains possible.
identity_multiple_candidates.reviewer_action: Confirm the exact ingredient identity from the supplier specification.

identity_related_forms.message: The submitted identifiers refer to related chemical forms that are not interchangeable exact identities.
identity_related_forms.reviewer_action: Confirm the exact chemical form supplied.

identity_secondary_identifier_unverified.message: One submitted identifier is recognised, but its relationship to the other identifier is not verified.
identity_secondary_identifier_unverified.reviewer_action: Verify the name and CAS association against the supplier specification.

identity_unresolved.message: Regulens could not establish one source-backed ingredient identity.
identity_unresolved.reviewer_action: Confirm the ingredient name and a reliable identifier.

impurity_trace_requirement.message: The rule requires an impurity or degradation product to remain at trace level.
impurity_trace_requirement.reviewer_action: Confirm the impurity or degradation-product level against the source requirement.

inactive_applicability_unresolved.message: An inactive source entry has unresolved current applicability.
inactive_applicability_unresolved.reviewer_action: Confirm the entry's current legal status from the official source.

nano_condition_unresolved.message: The rule contains particle-form or nano-specific requirements that remain unevaluated.
nano_condition_unresolved.reviewer_action: Confirm the material form and every nano-specific source condition.

preparation_stage_mismatch.message: The submitted concentration is for one stage, but the rule applies at a different stage.
preparation_stage_mismatch.reviewer_action: Confirm the concentration at the stage stated in the rule.

product_context_missing.message: The rule applies only to a stated product use, but that product information was not supplied.
product_context_missing.reviewer_action: Confirm the product category or use stated in the rule.

product_context_unverified.message: The submitted product description is not an exact source-backed regulatory context.
product_context_unverified.reviewer_action: Select or confirm the applicable source-backed product context.

regulated_function_dataset_incomplete.message: The applicable positive-list check is unavailable in the active dataset.
regulated_function_dataset_incomplete.reviewer_action: Review the intended function against the current official source.

regulated_function_missing.message: The ingredient matches a Singapore positive-list entry, but its intended function was not confirmed.
regulated_function_missing.reviewer_action: Confirm whether the ingredient is intended to act as the regulated function stated in the source.

regulated_function_not_listed.message: The ingredient was explicitly submitted for a regulated function but no matching entry was found in that Singapore positive list.
regulated_function_not_listed.reviewer_action: Confirm the intended function and the ingredient identity against the applicable Singapore list.

rule_exception_unresolved.message: This rule has an exception that still needs checking.
rule_exception_unresolved.reviewer_action: Check whether the exception shown in the regulatory source applies to this formulation.

rule_normalization_withheld.message: The source rule could not be represented as a reliable deterministic check.
rule_normalization_withheld.reviewer_action: Review the original source wording and all listed conditions.

screening_incomplete.message: At least one applicable regulatory check was withheld or could not be completed.
screening_incomplete.reviewer_action: Review each unresolved condition before relying on the screening result.

source_difference_material.message: Singapore and ACD impose different regulatory requirements for this use.
source_difference_material.reviewer_action: Review the exact requirements shown for each source; Regulens applies the Singapore requirement to this screening.

warning_requirement_unverified.message: The source contains a warning requirement whose applicability has not been established.
warning_requirement_unverified.reviewer_action: Check whether the warning condition applies; formulation screening does not confirm the label.
